map.美国 TIN 验证器。输入 9 位纳税人识别号，校验格式与结构合法性，用于美国报: US TIN validator. Enter a 9-digit taxpayer identification number; validate format and structural legality, for number-format checks in US tax filing, account opening, and compliance scenarios (does not verify authenticity).
map.格式 ^\\d{3}-?\\d{2}-?\\d{4}$（SSN 结构），并排除无: Format ^[0-9]{3}-?[0-9]{2}-?[0-9]{4}$ (SSN structure), excluding invalid segments (e.g. area code 000/666/9xx)
map.依据美国 TIN/SSN 结构规则校验 9 位纳税人识别号的格式与有效性区间；用: Validates the format and valid range of a 9-digit TIN/SSN per US rules; for number-format checks in tax filing, account opening, and compliance (does not verify authenticity).
map.校验 9 位 TIN/SSN/EIN 的格式与结构: Validate the format and structure of 9-digit TIN/SSN/EIN
map.美国报税、开户前对纳税人识别号做格式初检: Pre-check the taxpayer ID format before US tax filing or account opening
map.区分不同类型 TIN 的号段规则: Distinguish segment rules across TIN types
map.输入 9 位号码，页面按长度与号段结构校验；SSN 会额外检查是否落在禁用号段，: Enter a 9-digit number; the page checks length and segment structure; SSN additionally checks against disallowed segments, other types per their own rules.
map.TIN 是统称，包含 SSN（个人）、EIN（雇主）、ITIN（个人报税号）等，: TIN is an umbrella term covering SSN (individual), EIN (employer), ITIN (individual taxpayer), etc.; all 9 digits but with different segments and purposes.
map.TIN 有统一校验位吗？: Does TIN have a unified check digit?
map.没有公开统一的校验位算法，页面按长度与号段结构校验，SSN 另有禁用号段规则。: No public unified check-digit algorithm; the page checks length and segment structure, with SSN having additional disallowed-segment rules.
map.校验通过代表纳税号有效吗？: Does passing mean the tax number is valid?
map.不代表。须通过 IRS 官方工具核验。: No. Must be verified via the official IRS tool.
